Subject: Request: evidence package for sealed-site deployment (Midwest Bank)

Hi Kimberly,

As we discussed on the call, our compliance team needs the full evidence package for the sealed-site (VPC/on-prem) deployment you're scheduling for us. Specifically we need: a) final transport manifest with serials and checksums, b) signed manifest (PDF) with Redwood operator signature, c) chain-of-custody template filled with courier and operator names, d) operator onboarding checklist and contact window for the activation.

Target delivery date for the package is end-of-day Jan 12 so our audit team can review before the scheduled onsite activation the week of Jan 16. Please confirm whether Redwood will use a bonded courier (we prefer SecureTrans) and whether the operator will perform the final HSM key injection or if Midwest Bank ops will. We will need DocuSign on the signed manifest and proof of tamper-seal serials.

Thanks,
Liam

Liam — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver everything you requested. Plan and notes below: 

- Manifest: attaching manifest_v3.csv (working copy). It contains serials, SHA256 of images, package weight, and tamper-seal IDs. We'll finalize and produce signed PDF once you confirm the courier and acceptance window.
- Signing: Redwood operator will sign the manifest using our offline signing process; final PDF will be routed through DocuSign (link below) for Midwest Bank countersign.
- Chain of custody: we'll provide the filled template with courier and operator names. Courier will be bonded SecureTrans unless you instruct otherwise.
- HSM/key injection: Redwood can perform HSM key-wrapping at the activation site under your supervision; alternatively we can hand an encrypted key blob to your ops team prior to activation. Please confirm preference.
- Operator onboarding: Mina will run a 60-minute operator walk-through during the activation window; Jonas will be on-site for handoff if you want a Redwood engineer physically present.

Requested action: Can you confirm courier (SecureTrans OK) and whether Midwest will accept Redwood performing the final HSM unwrap on-site? If yes, we'll produce the signed-manifest-midwestbank.pdf and a DocuSign envelope by EOD Jan 10.

Links: DocuSign envelope (pending): https://www.docusign.com/sign/ABC123-midwest-manifest
